results.bound: $O(nk(w+k))\cdot\max(1,\mathsf{poly}(\log^* n - \log^*(w+k)))$ size and $O(\log n + \log w)$ depth
results.quote: There is a constant fan-in, constant fan-out boolean circuit that correctly sorts any array containing n elements each with a k-bit key and a w-bit payloads, whose size is \(O(nk(w+k))\cdot\mathrm{max}(1,\mathsf{poly}(\mathrm{log}^*n-\mathrm{log}^*(w+k)))\) and whose depth is \(O(\mathrm{log}n+\mathrm{log}w)\).

results.bound: $O(n)\cdot\min(k,\log n)$ total work and $O(\log n)$ depth
results.quote: There exists a deterministic oblivious parallel algorithm that sorts any input array containing n elements each with a k-bit key in \(O(n)\cdot min(k,logn)\) total work and \(O(\log n)\) depth, assuming that each element can be stored in \(O(1)\) words.

results.bound: $O(nw)\cdot\max(\mathsf{poly}(\log^* n - \log^* w),1)$ size and $O(\log n)$ depth
results.quote: There is an \((n,w)\)-tight compaction circuit with \(O(nw)\cdot max(\mathsf{poly}(log^*n-log^*w),1)\) generalized boolean gates, \(O(n)\cdot max(\mathsf{poly}(log^*n-log^*w),1)\) number of \(w\)-selector gates, and of depth \(O(\log n)\).

results.bound: $O(nk(w+k))\cdot(1+\log^* n - \log^*(w+k))$ size and $O(\log n + \log w)$ depth
results.quote: There is a constant fan-in, constant fan-out boolean circuit that correctly sorts any array containing n elements each with a k-bit key and a w-bit payloads, whose size is \(O(nk(w+k))\cdot(1+log^*n-log^*(w+k))\) and whose depth is \(O(\log n+\log w)\).

results.bound: $O(nw\cdot(1+\log^* n - \log^* w))$ size and $O(\log n)$ depth
results.previous_best: $O(nw)\cdot\max(\mathsf{poly}(\log^* n - \log^* w),1)$ size and $O(\log n)$ depth (Theorem 14.1)
results.quote: There exists a tight compaction circuit of size \(O(nw\cdot(1+\mathrm{log}^*(n)-\mathrm{log}^*(w)))\) and depth \(O(\log n)\), where \(w\) is the width of the payload.
